name: change_booking
description: Move an existing booking to another date or time, or change the number of guests. Needs the reference from find_booking and the caller's name and phone. Send only what changes. If you send a date, send its weekday too.

reference.description: The booking reference that find_booking returned for this caller, for example K7M2QX.

name.description: The caller's name, as they gave it.

phone.description: The caller's phone number, as they said it, including any leading zero or country code.

date.description: The new date as YYYY-MM-DD, in London, only if the date is changing. Always send the weekday with it.

weekday.description: The weekday of the new date, only when you send a date. If the caller named a weekday, give exactly that one.

time.description: The new start time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock, London time, only if the time is changing.

party_size.description: The new number of guests, only if it is changing.
